title.fr: La science, les découvertes et les inventions

text.en: Canada has moved science and technology forward in ways known around the world. That work changed how people everywhere talk to each other and do business.
text.fr: Le Canada a fait avancer la science et la technologie d'une manière reconnue partout dans le monde. Ces travaux ont changé la façon dont les gens communiquent et font des affaires.

source.quote: Canadian advances in science and technology are world renowned and have changed the way the world communicates and does business.

verification.evidence: Canadian advances in science and technology are world renowned and have changed the way the world communicates and does business.

text.en: Harold Innis and Marshall McLuhan were thinkers who broke new ground.
text.fr: Harold Innis et Marshall McLuhan ont été des penseurs qui ont ouvert la voie.

source.quote: Marshall McLuhan and Harold Innis were 50 pioneer thinkers.

verification.evidence: Canadian advances in science and technology are world renowned and have changed the way the world communicates and does business. Marshall McLuhan and Harold Innis were pioneer thinkers.

text.en: Research done in Canada is recognized around the world. It draws top students, teachers and business founders who work in fields such as medical research and telecommunications.
text.fr: La recherche menée au Canada est reconnue partout dans le monde. Elle attire des étudiants, des professeurs et des entrepreneurs de haut niveau qui travaillent dans des domaines comme la recherche médicale et les télécommunications.

source.quote: Science and research in Canada have won international recognition and attracted world-class students, academics and entrepreneurs engaged in medical research, telecommunications and other fields.

verification.evidence: Science and research in Canada have won international recognition and attracted world-class students, academics and entrepreneurs engaged in medical research, telecommunications and other fields.

text.en: Nobel Prize winners in science include Bertram Brockhouse, Michael Smith, Richard E. Taylor, Sidney Altman, John Polanyi and Gerhard Herzberg, who was a refugee from Nazi Germany.
text.fr: Parmi les lauréats d'un prix Nobel en sciences, on compte Bertram Brockhouse, Michael Smith, Richard E. Taylor, Sidney Altman, John Polanyi et Gerhard Herzberg, qui était un réfugié de l'Allemagne nazie.

source.quote: Gerhard Herzberg, a refugee from Nazi Germany, John Polanyi, Sidney Altman, Richard E. Taylor, Michael Smith and Bertram Brockhouse were Nobel Prize-winning scientists.

verification.evidence: Gerhard Herzberg, a refugee from Nazi Germany, John Polanyi, Sidney Altman, Richard E. Taylor, Michael Smith and Bertram Brockhouse were Nobel Prize-winning scientists.

text.en: Since 1989, the Canadian Space Agency and Canadian astronauts have helped explore space. They have often used the Canadarm, which was designed and built in Canada.
text.fr: Depuis 1989, l'Agence spatiale canadienne et des astronautes canadiens participent à l'exploration spatiale. Ils utilisent souvent le Canadarm, conçu et construit au Canada.

source.quote: Since 1989, the Canadian Space Agency and Canadian astronauts have participated in space exploration, often using the Canadian-designed and built Canadarm.

verification.evidence: Since 1989, the Canadian Space Agency and Canadian astronauts have participated in space exploration, often using the Canadian-designed and built Canadarm.

text.en: Alexander Graham Bell came up with the idea for the telephone while he was at his summer home in Canada.
text.fr: Alexander Graham Bell a eu l'idée du téléphone pendant un séjour à sa maison d'été, au Canada.

source.quote: Alexander Graham Bell — hit on the idea of the telephone at his summer house in Canada.

verification.evidence: Alexander Graham Bell — hit on the idea of the telephone at his summer house in Canada.

text.en: Joseph-Armand Bombardier invented the snowmobile, a light vehicle for getting around in winter.
text.fr: Joseph-Armand Bombardier a inventé la motoneige, un véhicule léger pour se déplacer en hiver.

source.quote: Joseph-Armand Bombardier — invented the snowmobile, a light-weight winter vehicle.

verification.evidence: Joseph-Armand Bombardier — invented the snowmobile, a light-weight winter vehicle.

text.en: Sir Sandford Fleming invented standard time zones. The whole world uses his system.
text.fr: Sir Sandford Fleming a inventé les fuseaux horaires normalisés. Le monde entier utilise son système.

source.quote: Sir Sandford Fleming — invented the worldwide system of standard time zones.

verification.evidence: Sir Sandford Fleming — invented the worldwide system of standard time zones.

text.en: Matthew Evans and Henry Woodward invented the first electric light bulb together. Later, they sold the patent to Thomas Edison.
text.fr: Matthew Evans et Henry Woodward ont inventé ensemble la première ampoule électrique. Plus tard, ils ont vendu le brevet à Thomas Edison.

source.quote: Matthew Evans and Henry Woodward — together invented the first electric light bulb and later sold the patent to Thomas Edison

verification.evidence: Matthew Evans and Henry Woodward — together invented the first electric light bulb and later sold the patent to Thomas Edison

text.en: Thomas Edison is the name most people know when it comes to the light bulb, because Edison turned it into something that could be sold.
text.fr: C'est le nom de Thomas Edison que la plupart des gens associent à l'ampoule électrique, parce qu'Edison en a fait un produit à vendre.

source.quote: Thomas Edison who, more famously, commercialized the light bulb.

verification.evidence: Matthew Evans and Henry Woodward — together invented the first electric light bulb and later sold the patent to Thomas Edison who, more famously, commercialized the light bulb.

text.en: Reginald Fessenden helped to invent radio. He sent the world's first voice message without wires.
text.fr: Reginald Fessenden a contribué à l'invention de la radio. Il a envoyé le premier message vocal sans fil au monde.

source.quote: Reginald Fessenden — contributed to the invention of radio, sending the first wireless voice message in the world.

verification.evidence: Reginald Fessenden — contributed to the invention of radio, sending the first wireless voice message in the world.

text.en: Dr. Wilder Penfield broke new ground in brain surgery at McGill University in Montreal. In his lifetime, people called him the greatest living Canadian.
text.fr: Le Dr Wilder Penfield a ouvert de nouvelles voies en chirurgie du cerveau à l'Université McGill, à Montréal. De son vivant, on l'appelait le plus grand des Canadiens vivants.

source.quote: Dr. Wilder Penfield — was a pioneering brain surgeon at McGill University in Montreal, and was known as “the greatest living Canadian.”

verification.evidence: Dr. Wilder Penfield — was a pioneering brain surgeon at McGill University in Montreal, and was known as “the greatest living Canadian.”

text.en: Dr. John A. Hopps invented the first pacemaker for the heart. Today it saves the lives of people with heart problems.
text.fr: Le Dr John A. Hopps a inventé le premier stimulateur cardiaque. Aujourd'hui, il sauve la vie de personnes qui ont des troubles cardiaques.

source.quote: Dr. John A. Hopps — invented the first cardiac pacemaker, used today to save the lives of people with heart disorders.

verification.evidence: Dr. John A. Hopps — invented the first cardiac pacemaker, used today to save the lives of people with heart disorders.

text.en: The Canadarm is a robot arm built for use in space. SPAR Aerospace and the National Research Council invented it.
text.fr: Le Canadarm est un bras robotisé conçu pour être utilisé dans l'espace. Il a été inventé par SPAR Aerospace et le Conseil national de recherches.

source.quote: SPAR Aerospace / National Research Council — invented the Canadarm, a robotic arm used in outer space.

verification.evidence: SPAR Aerospace / National Research Council — invented the Canadarm, a robotic arm used in outer space.

text.en: Sir Frederick Banting, of Toronto, and Charles Best discovered insulin. It is a hormone used to treat diabetes, and it has saved millions of lives around the world.
text.fr: Sir Frederick Banting, de Toronto, et Charles Best ont découvert l'insuline. C'est une hormone qui sert à traiter le diabète, et elle a sauvé des millions de vies dans le monde.

source.quote: Sir Frederick Banting of Toronto and Charles Best discovered insulin, a hormone to treat diabetes that has saved 16 million lives worldwide

verification.evidence: Sir Frederick Banting of Toronto and Charles Best discovered insulin, a hormone to treat diabetes that has saved 16 million lives worldwide

text.en: Jim Balsillie and Mike Lazaridis worked at the wireless communications company Research in Motion (RIM). The invention RIM is most famous for is the BlackBerry.
text.fr: Jim Balsillie et Mike Lazaridis travaillaient à Research in Motion (RIM), une entreprise de communications sans fil. L'invention la plus célèbre de RIM est le BlackBerry.

source.quote: Mike Lazaridis and Jim Balsillie — of Research in Motion (RIM)—a wireless communications company known for its most famous invention—the BlackBerry.

verification.evidence: Mike Lazaridis and Jim Balsillie — of Research in Motion (RIM)—a wireless communications company known for its most famous invention—the BlackBerry.
